2610.13057.title: CoBe: A Benchmark For Conversational Counterfactual Text Editing
2610.13057.paper_summary: Counterfactual text editing is the ability to revise a given text in light of a hypothetical change while preserving facts not causally affected by that change. When asked what would have happened if a doctor had not recommended surgery, the model output should retain the patient's medical history and modify only the consequences of the decision. This requires causal understanding: a model must determine, without being explicitly instructed to, what events are affected by the hypothetical change and what should remain fixed. This skill is central to human reasoning, especially in safety-critical domains like healthcare or law. By contrast, the task of associational text generation merely generates text statistically associated with the altered condition. In the medical example, an associational response might make the patient's symptoms less severe because milder cases correlate with no surgery. Such responses produce a plausible scenario, but not the counterfactual version of the given one. Prior counterfactual-text datasets do not clearly separate these modes of reasoning. We introduce the Counterfactual Benchmark (CoBe), a testbed for models' zero-shot ability to counterfactually edit a given textual scenario when prompted to do so in a conversationally natural way. CoBe contains 2000 questions spanning healthcare, science and engineering, business, and everyday scenarios. We test a suite of frontier and smaller models, with frontier systems achieving an average score of $58.05\%$. Our findings indicate that models frequently default to associational generation rather than preserving the causal structure of the original scenario. Moreover, performance does not scale consistently with either model size or output token length, suggesting that the failure may reflect model training objectives rather than insufficient model capacity.
2610.13057.paper_summary_zh: 反事實文本編輯是根據假設性變更修訂給定文本的能力，同時保留不受該變更因果影響的事實。當被問及如果一位醫生沒有建議手術會發生什麼時，模型的輸出應保留病人的病歷，僅修改決策的後果。這需要因果理解：模型必須在未被明確指示的情況下判斷哪些事件受到假設性變更的影響，哪些應保持不變。這項技能對於人類推理至關重要，特別是在醫療或法律等安全關鍵領域。相比之下，關聯文本生成的任務僅僅是生成與變更條件統計相關的文本。在醫療範例中，關聯性回應可能會使病人的症狀變得不那麼嚴重，因為輕微病例與不進行手術相關聯。這樣的回應產生了一個合理的情境，但不是給定情境的反事實版本。先前的反事實文本數據集並未明確區分這些推理模式。我們引入了反事實基準（CoBe），這是一個測試模型在被提示以自然對話方式進行反事實編輯時的零-shot能力的測試平台。CoBe包含2000個問題，涵蓋醫療、科學與工程、商業和日常情境。我們測試了一系列前沿和較小的模型，前沿系統的平均得分為$58.05\%$。我們的發現表明，模型經常默認為關聯生成，而不是保留原始情境的因果結構。此外，性能並未隨著模型大小或輸出標記長度的一致性擴展，這表明失敗可能反映模型訓練目標而非模型容量不足。
